data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 and 2016 years of account have seen positive claims experience and the RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves. The 2015 underwriting year was closed at year end by means of a reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction and all liabilities transferred to a third party syndicate. The RITC yielded a profit for the Syndicate of GBP 49m as the premium was below the booked reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year claims reserve release of GBP 53.783 million in 2017. This was primarily driven by positive claims experience on the 2015 and 2016 years of account, and an outwards Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction for the 2015 underwriting year which yielded a net profit of GBP 49 million.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle, as it represents the movement in claims reserves more directly than the overall underwriting result for prior years of account. The RITC profit of GBP 49m mentioned in the narrative is a net figure and is likely reflected in the 2015 underwriting year's claims development.
